description: [WRITE] Create a Pinterest Conversions API SERVER tag from the official template (pinterest/ss-gtm-template), imported automatically. advertiserId is the Pinterest Ad Account ID (549 followed by 9 digits, from Ads Manager; NOT the web Tag ID), apiAccessToken the Conversions API token. Omit `event` to inherit the incoming event name (auto-mapped); pass a Pinterest standard event (checkout, lead, signup, …) or a GA4 name to force one. containerId must be the SERVER container. Needs a SERVER trigger (triggers_create) passed as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

advertiserId.description: Pinterest Ad Account ID (549 followed by 9 digits), not the web Tag ID.

apiAccessToken.description: Pinterest Conversions API token, usually a {{variable}} so it is not stored in plain text on the tag.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

name.description: Tag name; defaults to "Pinterest CAPI Tag".

name: create_pinterest_capi_server_tag
